chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Returns to Mortal World: Yellow River Mysteries Await
chapter_meta_description: In this chapter, Xiao Chen returns home after eight years, heals his parents, and uncovers dark secrets along the Yellow River involving the Ancestral Dragon Platform and Heavenly Stele.
og_title: Xiao Chen's Homecoming: Secrets of the Yellow River
og_description: After eight years in the World of Immortality, Xiao Chen returns to his mortal village, finding both family warmth and troubling mysteries at the Yellow River.
